In recent years, the conversation around nutrition has shifted from simple calorie counting to more nuanced approaches like targeted eating patterns. These methods emphasize specific dietary goals—such as reduced caloric intake or controlled digestion—to optimize health outcomes. Unlike traditional diets that focus solely on weight loss, targeted eating patterns often center on metabolic flexibility, gut health, and nutrient density. Common approaches include:
